thread:
maria_g: Got DSAR (EU) requesting full erasure incl embeddings and chat history. Legal flagged possible retention exception for an internal audit — hold ID AUD-221. Need technical plan for keystore snapshots and proof artifacts. @legal-team
legal-team: Confirmed identity proof and placed a temporary hold AUD-221. Hold window ~48-72h. Prepare proof of what would be deleted; do not run delete while hold is active.
raj_patel: We should produce a signed proof JSON and S3 listing for chain-of-custody. Also check for any vuln triage referencing this user.
sophie: User has snapshots in eu-west1 (snap-eu-221) encrypted with projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/key-main and a us-central1 mirror. There is also an orphaned backfill snapshot flagged by retention tool.
maria_g: Proposed steps: 1) freeze write ops for user 2) create timebound role ad_hoc:custodian:AUD-221 for keystore ops (45m) 3) rewrap EU snapshot to ephemeral HSM key 4) run `keystore verify --snapshot snap-eu-221 --proof-out=aud-221-proof.json` 5) upload proof to s3://priv-proofs/AUD-221/ and share with Legal 6) if hold removed, run delete job and record receipts; else keep snapshots and attach proof.
infra-oncall: I can create the role and grant to infra-oncall SA for 45m. Will include audit label `reason=DSAR-AUD-221`. Need approvers.
raj_patel: Approvers: @sophie + @maria_g.
sophie: Approved. Limit perms to roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on ephemeral key only.
infra-oncall: Granting now. Audit entry: https://audit.internal/entries/AUD-221-grant :lock:
infra-oncall: Commands run:
```
# create ephemeral key
gcloud kms keys create ephemeral-aud-221 --location=eu-west1 --keyring=ephemeral-rg
# bind minimal IAM
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/ephemeral-aud-221 --member=serviceAccount:infra-oncall@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
# rewrap snapshot
keystore rewrap --snapshot=snap-eu-221 --to-key=projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/ephemeral-aud-221 --ephemeral-ttl=1h
# verify and export proof
keystore verify --snapshot=snap-eu-221 --proof-out=aud-221-proof.json
# upload proof
aws s3 cp aud-221-proof.json s3://priv-proofs/AUD-221/
```
infra-oncall: Rewrap and verify succeeded, proof uploaded, pre-op S3 listing attached to the audit entry. :white_check_mark:
maria_g: Verified proof and shared with Legal. Marked snapshot metadata `hold:AUD-221`. No deletion performed.
legal-team: Received proof. Hold remains for now. Open retention-exception ticket PRIV-221 for Finance ops.
raj_patel: Follow-up: add runbook to automate timebound custodian role creation and require signed proof JSON format.
security-bot: Log saved to Vault under AUD-221.
